name: Webform media
description: Provides media source for webforms to allow embedding in pages
project_description:
Back to top 

 Overview 
 Provides a media-type for webforms, allowing site-builders to configure the media-embed input filter so that content-editors can embed webforms in CKEditor.

 The project implements a new media type source, so a new media type bundle is set up with the source.

 Users then create new media, where each media has a reference field pointing to a Webform.

 The webform media can then be embedded as you would with any other media, via CKE's Media Library button.

 For more guidance, including configuration and installation, see the README.

 Back to top 

 Features 
 Provides a webform media type

 Back to top 

 Requirements 
 
 Webform module 
 Media and Media Library modules in core
